personal.bio_en: Passionate software developer with a strong foundation in programming and application development. Extensive knowledge of programming languages such as Dart, PHP, CSS, and JavaScript, and proficient in utilizing various frameworks and development tools.

personal.aboutText_en: I am a Full-Stack and Mobile Developer based in Surabaya, Indonesia. With over 3 years of hands-on experience in building scalable web applications and high-performance mobile apps, I enjoy solving complex problems and turning ideas into responsive digital solutions. I am constantly learning new technologies and improving my skills to deliver state-of-the-art products.
personal.aboutText_id: Saya adalah Full-Stack dan Mobile Developer yang berbasis di Surabaya, Indonesia. Dengan pengalaman praktis lebih dari 3 tahun dalam membangun aplikasi web yang skalabel dan aplikasi mobile berkinerja tinggi, saya senang memecahkan masalah kompleks dan mengubah ide menjadi solusi digital yang responsif. Saya terus mempelajari teknologi baru dan meningkatkan keahlian saya untuk menghadirkan produk mutakhir.

bullets_en: Lead the design, development, and maintenance of internal applications, including the Logistic Management System (LMS), optimizing operational efficiency.
Developed and managed mobile applications (iOS & Android) for logistics operations using Laravel, Vue, Node.js, and Flutter, enhancing functionality and user engagement.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure a reliable and scalable application infrastructure, resulting in a 30% reduction in operational delays.

Mengembangkan dan mengelola aplikasi mobile (iOS & Android) untuk operasi logistik menggunakan Laravel, Vue, Node.js, dan Flutter, meningkatkan fungsionalitas dan interaksi pengguna.
Berkolaborasi dengan tim lintas fungsi untuk memastikan infrastruktur aplikasi yang andal dan skalabel, menghasilkan pengurangan keterlambatan operasional sebesar 30%.

bullets_en: Designed and maintained responsive websites and applications, working with technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Developed front-end and back-end functionalities using frameworks like Node, React, Vue, Flutter, and Laravel, achieving faster and more efficient project deployment.
Enhanced application responsiveness and user interface, ensuring a positive and seamless user experience.

bullets_en: Assisted in the development and maintenance of applications to meet user preferences, utilizing Laravel and Vue.js.
